tool_args.rationale: Acquire additional trajectory observations before fitting the coupled memory ODE. The current five rows do not adequately identify its four parameters.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the coupled memory ODE to the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five rows leave the four-parameter coupled transient model insufficiently constrained; the mechanism note calls for at least eight.
The extra trajectory batch directly supplies observations needed to identify the coupled ODE parameters.
The pilot signatures indicate history dependence and coupled transient lag that these single-mode alternatives do not capture.
